messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When I set out, my knee started playing up a bit but it settled down really quickly and I never heard another thing from it after a kilometre or two.

output.original_text: When I set out, my knee started playing up a bit but it settled down really quickly and I never heard another thing from it after a kilometre or two.
output.joy: When I set out, my knee gave me a little trouble, but it settled down almost instantly, and I couldn't believe how great it felt after just a kilometre or two!
output.sadness: When I set out, my knee started acting up a bit, and even though it settled down quickly, I can't help but feel that worry lingered in my mind for the next kilometre or two.
output.fear: When I set out, my knee started playing up unexpectedly, and I was so worried it wouldn't settle down, but thankfully, it did just after a kilometre or two.
output.anger: When I set out, my knee started acting up annoyingly, but it settled down quickly, and honestly, I just wanted to forget it after a kilometre or two.
output.surprise: When I set out, my knee surprised me by acting up a bit, but it settled down really quickly, and I was amazed it didn't bother me after a kilometre or two!
output.disgust: When I set out, my knee started playing up a bit, which was so frustrating; thankfully, it settled down quickly and I didn’t have to deal with it for longer than a kilometre or two.
